data.name: Lakshman
data.gender_notes: Lakshman is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit lakṣaṇa, 'a mark, sign' — Lakṣmaṇa. Its root is Sanskrit lakṣ (लक्ष्). Lakshmana, brother of Rama. Lakshman is a Sanskrit name meaning “Auspicious mark; Rama's brother”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Lakshman expresses “Auspicious mark; Rama's brother”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit lakṣaṇa, 'a mark, sign' — Lakṣmaṇa.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lakshman total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
